entities.name: Table T1 – Morgan Stanley AI Coding Model Performance and Cost Comparison
entities.brief: Comparison of AI coding models' accuracy, cost, and formatting performance
entities.description: Shows trade-offs between accuracy, cost, and edit format quality of various AI coding models, informing investment and implementation decisions in AI-driven software development.

properties.table_content:
| Model | Percent correct | Cost | Command | Correct edit format |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| o3 (high) + gpt-4.1 | 82.7% | $69.29 | aider --model o3 --architect | 100.0% |
| o3 (high) | 79.6% | $111.03 | aider --model o3 | 95.1% |
| Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview 05-06 | 76.9% | $37.41 | aider --model gemini/gemini-2.5-pro-preview-05-06 | 97.3% |
| Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview 03-25 | 72.9% | $29.74 (est.) | aider --model gemini/gemini-2.5-pro-preview-03-25 | 92.4% |
| o4-mini (high) | 72.0% | $19.64 | aider --model o4-mini | 90.7% |
| claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219 (32k thinking tokens) | 64.9% | $36.83 | aider --model anthropic/claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219 --thinking-tokens 32k | 97.8% |
| DeepSeek R1 + claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 | 64.0% | $13.29 | aider --architect --model r1 --editor-model sonnet | 100.0% |
properties.key_insight: Models range from 64.0% to 82.7% accuracy with costs from $13.29 to $111.03 and no clear correlation between accuracy and cost.
